name: WARNING: Outback Kookaburra Wings (Fried Skin, Garlic & Cayenne Sauce)
whyItWorks: Deep-fried skin-on chicken wings drenched in tangy cayenne and garlic butter sauce, served with blue cheese and stringy celery sticks. Deep frying + capsaicin + blue cheese mold triggers intense GI cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip wings entirely. Choose unbattered, skinless Grilled Chicken on the Barbie.
